query: SELECT * FROM duckdb_views() WHERE database_name='x509' ORDER BY schema_name,view_name
rows: Registry of certificate attributes: each field, the scalar function that returns it, and its result type.

rows.vgi.doc_llm: A browsable registry of every certificate attribute this worker can read: each row maps a field name (the same field cert_info emits) to the scalar function that returns it and to that value's DuckDB result type. Query it to discover the worker's certificate surface without first parsing a certificate blob.
rows.vgi.doc_md: A browsable registry mapping each certificate attribute to the scalar function that returns it and that value's DuckDB type. Columns: `field`, `scalar_function`, `result_type`, `description`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the certificate fields whose scalar function returns a BOOLEAN, with the function name.","sql":"SELECT field, scalar_function FROM x509.main.cert_fields WHERE result_type = 'BOOLEAN' ORDER BY field"}]
rows.vgi.title: Certificate Field Registry

rows: CREATE VIEW cert_fields AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('subject', 'cert_subject', 'VARCHAR', 'Subject distinguished name (RFC 2253).'), ('issuer', 'cert_issuer', 'VARCHAR', 'Issuer distinguished name of the signing CA (RFC 2253).'), ('serial', 'cert_serial', 'VARCHAR', 'Serial number as a decimal string.'), ('not_before', 'cert_not_before', 'TIMESTAMP', 'Start of the validity window (UTC).'), ('not_after', 'cert_not_after', 'TIMESTAMP', 'End of the validity window / expiry (UTC).'), ('is_expired', 'cert_is_expired', 'BOOLEAN', 'Whether the certificate is outside its validity window right now.'), ('key_algorithm', 'cert_key_algorithm', 'VARCHAR', 'Public-key algorithm with size or curve (e.g. RSA-2048, ECDSA-P256).'), ('signature_algorithm', 'cert_signature_algorithm', 'VARCHAR', 'Algorithm used to sign the certificate (e.g. ECDSA-SHA256).'), ('fingerprint_sha256', 'cert_fingerprint', 'VARCHAR', 'SHA-256 fingerprint of the DER encoding (lowercase hex).'), ('is_ca', 'cert_is_ca', 'BOOLEAN', 'Whether the certificate is a certificate-authority (CA) certificate.'), ('sans', 'cert_sans', 'VARCHAR[]', 'Subject alternative names: DNS names then IP addresses.')) AS valueslist) AS t(field, scalar_function, result_type, description);
